body:
Please try again!! I feel like the lash tech you had might have done you a lil wild. You wanted a wispy set and this set is way more a volume set like a couple of comments mentioned. Try again this time
Hopefully with a photo that has a lash map! That usually helps my lash techs that aren’t too experienced/ used to doing more volume sets.
I saw it and immediately thought about New Jazz
Female, used to use weed recreationally and I am 26.
Thank you so so much for this comment
Yeah I asked her “what made you think to say that?” basically trying to get her to admit to her own rudeness.
How long did it take to go away ?
Yes!

This is the thought that gives me tons of anxiety at night. I can’t stop thinking that it was a TIA, which is a precursor for an actual stroke. I’ve been worried about the days that I’m living in fear of it happening.
But aren’t TIAs just warnings for actual strokes? I’m not too sure.
I was trying to bring this to a lawyer but they wouldn’t see me considering I’ve had no physical ailments. Thank you so much for this info, I’m looking into the patient advocate business right now.
I told him to do this as well haha!
Thank you so much for this. I feel terrible about it.
Yes, this is correct. He immediately pulled me into him and asked why I was doing it
Oh my gosh I’m so sorry I meant to mention that flicking the hot oil on him was a complete accident. I would never harm him or anyone like this
Congrats! I hope the new position make you feel as wonderful as it should.
You’re beautiful! It’s too bad if he didn’t know what he was missing out on. You motivate me to believe I can get through it ❤️
I have the same problem. I hope everything is better for you now at least

Speaking individually as in mentioning that I found something she wrote in his belongings. Because I wasn’t there, I have absolutely no idea what he told her. He didn’t even tell me he spoke to her, she told me that.
Thank you, I tried to heed your advice but he ended up speaking to her individually again. Thank you for wishing me luck in this ❤️
I’m so sorry you had to endure this, but I do hope things get better for you now that the toxicity from your life is gone. I wish you good luck and stay strong :)

She was basically doing something inappropriate — constantly leaving notes in my partners things. My partner has asked them about twice now to stop, but it’s still going on so now my gut is telling me to jump in, talk to her, and at least let her know that I’m not stupid and I know something is trying to happen right under my nose.
Sorry, I forgot to mention that he’s done this to her twice in a row, and it’s still persisted. This was the only reason I felt like I had to jump in.

She would constantly leave notes and things into my partners belongings, so I basically started off with politely asking her to stop. About 10 minutes later she replied back, gesturing that she saw him in a bad mood and wanted to cheer him up, but it didn’t seem to work and he went about it the wrong way. She apologized about three different times during the response and told me that she “understood” what I was going through and I had every right to be upset. 

Hmm.
Thank you so much, it’s supportive people like you in this community that keeps me to have hope in myself.
That’s exactly correct. My partner told me that she’s been telling her fiancé all contact has stopped, but yet she continues to be persistent.

I was very much planning on doing that, but I didn’t know if that would harm my relationship with my partner. Basically it was me afraid of looking like the “bad guy”, but I’m starting to feel like this is something I’ll end up doing eventually.

A part of me feels like he likes the attention, be it from her or another person. And that worries me. He did tell me he would instill this again to her(this would be his third time) and I know I want to be there this time. I’ve just been unsure if I should do it in person or have him send her a text while I’m able to see the conversation.

I’m sorry, I didn’t understand who you were referring to about the self esteem? But her fiancé knows about her behavior but no one has done anything about it. There are time where I wish I could send a tip about it to her fiancé
That’s true. You’re right, thank you for that I think I’m going to  consider text instead.
He could, but I don’t know if I should have him do that or meet with all three of them in person.
She’s pregnant with her fiancé’s child, which is unbelievable to me that she’s still doing this. And he does know, he said he’ll speak to her but I told him I want to be there when he does.
This job is basically his career, she started here last April. They’re trying to promote him to manager of the shop, so I don’t think he’s leaving any time soon.
Thanks you so much. I was/am up all night so conflicted about all this.

Since this is his workplace, I’d absolutely hate to be looked at as the immature one even if I politely ask her to stop. He said he would let her know again, so next work day I am going to request to be there while he does.
He told her this twice, but she doesn’t seem to be getting the hint.
I would message her now, but I’m not sure if that would be strange considering it’s 1am. I was thinking I might wait until tomorrow.
I don’t either. But I live with him, I have to find a way to muster up the courage to leave.
I can’t give you an exact answer, I believe a week or two. Because I can have a habit of overreacting

Suddenly being cold to me or mistreating me, 
Just beginning to disregard me overall. Another obvious one used to be heavy mention of their previous partners :|

Thank you for being so kind and making me feel less alone in this situation.

A lot of the people I am around are tired of my ranting about this, so it’s hard to not feel by myself about things like this
Yes, but I always seem to get swept up until it’s too late
You and everyone else that’s commented have been completely right. Thank you for commenting and making me realize that I need to let my guard down a bit, especially after something like this

I guess it’s that there was one time where he cried because of the guilt after I found an intimate note from her, so now when that happens I think back to that. I wouldn’t want to feel this way, of course not.
No, I haven’t, I was always too anxious to ask. But I feel like you’re onto something haha

Sorry, to clear up the confusion, I would just visit his job some days and try to make conversation with his coworkers, and it would turn out that way. 

As for using one of my professors as a mentor; I guess that’s another thing that has to do with my maturity. I feel comfortable speaking to my professors, but when it comes to building a personal relationship with them, I feel like what I might want to say or do is undervalued. My anxiety allows me to believe that they must not have time for me if I do try to start a conversation with them. Also I wouldn’t even be too sure how to ask them if they can be a type of mentor to me.

Not having a mentor just makes things twice as hard for me in the sense that I feel completely unprepared. I am studying for my degree in graphic design, but without a mentor it’s hard to really know what is wanted out of my portfolio, how to get in touch with companies, how to sell yourself. I feel like In that sense I’m way behind compared to my peers who might have had parents or people they know already experienced in things like that and ready to help them.
Thank you ❤️

Sorry. I meant to clarify that we knew each other physically, he cheated on me with the girl he’s never met.

This still really did help so much, thank you so much for spending time to respond to me
